$comment: Drama Studio host lifecycle registration (U13). One SessionStart hook, timeout 10 seconds, exactly the budget studio_check.py enforces for itself. The handler is local, bounded, and read-only toward the studio: it asks U2's POST /api/studio/checkin whether an order is waiting and prints at most one line. It matches the startup source only, so a resume or a clear prints nothing; it is silent on every error and exits 0. The desktop notice is a separate path (studio_check.py --desktop) and fires only when the client opted in. Nothing here is registered in any settings.json: the hook loads from this skill folder (decision 11).
